project.description: Tool-driven generation: an /ask endpoint whose assistant calls a tool (a catalog lookup) to answer a question it cannot answer on its own, across Spring AI on Spring Boot (@Tool + defaultTools), LangChain4j on Spring Boot (@Tool + AiServices.tools), and LangChain4j on Quarkus (@RegisterAiService(tools = ...)).
